name: Rule-Based
title: Rule-Based Authentication Template
summary: Prompts 2FA or denies the login based on a risk score computed from configurable, weighted rules.
preRequisites: Modify the 1st and 2nd factor authentication option(s) from defaults as required.

Change the parameters at the top of the script as needed to match the requirements. Enable or disable each rule in riskRules, and set its weight (0 to 100) and the values it checks. A disabled rule adds nothing to the risk score, whatever its weight. Use whole numbers.
The risk score is the sum of the weights that the rules add. Set stepUpThreshold and denyThreshold to the risk scores at which 2FA is prompted and the login is denied.
Set forceStepUp to true on a rule to prompt 2FA whenever that rule adds its weight, even if the risk score is below stepUpThreshold. The login is still denied if the risk score reaches denyThreshold.
Change the corpNetwork parameter to an array of trusted ip ranges.
For the loginAttemptsBased rule, enable Login Attempts Security.
For the roleBased rule, associate the roles in rolesToStepUp with the application (Roles tab of the application). Roles that are not associated with the application are not checked.
For the siftRiskScore rule, configure the Sift connector.
For the elkRiskBased rule, set the Elasticsearch host and port in the ELK Analytics settings.

parametersDescription.stepUpThreshold: Risk score at or above which 2FA is prompted.
parametersDescription.denyThreshold: Risk score at or above which the login is denied.
parametersDescription.errorMessage: Message shown when the login is denied.
parametersDescription.riskRules: The rules used to compute the risk score. Some rules flag suspicious logins, such as a login from a new device, and some flag sensitive accounts, such as administrators. When the risk score reaches stepUpThreshold, 2FA is prompted, and when it reaches denyThreshold, the login is denied. Every rule has 'enabled', 'weight' and 'forceStepUp', and the values it checks.
parametersDescription.riskRules.ipBased.corpNetwork: Trusted IP address ranges. The weight is added for logins from outside these ranges.
parametersDescription.riskRules.newDeviceBased.cookieName: A user-defined cookie name to be used for device identification.
parametersDescription.riskRules.newDeviceBased.deviceRememberP: The length of time in seconds for which this device should be remembered as a trusted device. Once this time period passes, login attempts are considered as new device logins.
parametersDescription.riskRules.loginAttemptsBased.invalidAtte: Number of failed login attempts. The weight is added when the user has at least this many.
parametersDescription.riskRules.roleBased.rolesToStepUp: Roles that need extra protection, such as administrators. The weight is added for users with any of these roles. Only roles associated with the application are checked.
parametersDescription.riskRules.groupBased.groupsToStepUp: Groups that need extra protection. The weight is added for users in any of these groups.
parametersDescription.riskRules.userStoreBased.userStoresToSte: User stores that need extra protection. The weight is added for users from any of these user stores.
parametersDescription.riskRules.activeSessions.allowedActiveSe: Maximum number of active sessions per user. The weight is added when the user has more. Sessions reused through single sign-on are counted.
parametersDescription.riskRules.siftRiskScore.riskThreshold: Sift risk score above which the weight is added, as a percentage (50 for 0.5).
parametersDescription.riskRules.siftRiskScore.addWeightOnFailu: Whether to add the weight when the Sift risk score cannot be retrieved.
parametersDescription.riskRules.siftRiskScore.additionalParams: Additional parameters to send to Sift.
parametersDescription.riskRules.elkRiskBased: The weight is added when the ELK risk score is above 0.
parametersDescription.riskRules.elkRiskBased.addWeightOnFailur: Whether to add the weight when the ELK risk score cannot be retrieved.
